_note: Tracked, server-lane seed registry for GENERAL (non-drawing.write) catalog tools whose only reachable implementation is a server/builtins/*.py file that engine/registry.json (Lane B) does not itself carry. deps.all_tools() folds these in additively (same mechanism as write_tools.json) so a tenant POST /api/run resolves them by name via deps.find_tool. Kept separate from write_tools.json (drawing.write tools) and the gitignored authored_tools.json (harness-authored tools).

tools.name: autofill-string-targets
tools.description: Derive string targets from the drawing's panel polylines: bank-clustered, rotation-aware serpentine DC string routing over the Panels layer with an NEC 690.7 cold-temperature string-size check. Read-only; runs server/builtins/string_panels.py against the intake.

voc.description: Module open-circuit voltage at STC, volts (demo default).

design_min_temp_c.description: Design minimum ambient temperature, degC (demo default).

max_system_voltage.description: NEC 690.7 maximum system voltage, volts (commercial-rooftop demo default).

panel_layer.description: Intake layer carrying the closed panel polylines.

cluster_radius_factor.description: Bank clustering radius as a multiple of the median nearest-neighbor panel distance; strings never cross bank gaps.

tools.name: instant-list-layers
tools.description: Lists layers from the drawing context preloaded when the session opens.
